acceptance_condition: accept only if the reviewer can justify source-side synthesis without endpoint residuals, endpoint scores, or fit feedback

question_text: Does the negative Row2-only diagnostic remain compatible with the route-wide multi-row interpretation, rather than constituting a route falsification?
acceptance_condition: accept only if Row2 is treated as locally weak but not the sole carrier of the full route signal

question_text: May the route advance only to a future separate validation-oriented gate preparation, while keeping current replay, endpoint validation, physical validation, and route-promotion claims false?
acceptance_condition: accept only if no current replay authorization, endpoint validation, physical validation, or physical discovery claim is made

question_text: Are any remaining source-side blockers or caveats substantial enough to require more source acquisition before even preparing a later validation-oriented gate?
acceptance_condition: reviewer must list blockers if the synthesis is not sufficient; allowed outcomes remain source-side only
